standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-theoretic support of a coherent sheaf and the projection formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-coherent-support-closed (tag 01Y5) and Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-projection-formula (tag 01E8)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the closed immersion i : Z -> X and computes F tensor E through i_*.

core_obligations: Write F = i_*G for the inclusion i : Z -> X of the scheme-theoretic support of F, whose underlying space is Supp(F), and note that Z has dimension zero (proof lines 6225-6230).

Deduce that Z is affine, hence G is globally generated with vanishing higher cohomology; using that Z is a finite disjoint union of spectra of local Artinian rings, identify H^0(Z, G) with the direct sum of the stalks G_z (proof lines 6230-6239).

Transfer these statements to F using that the cohomologies of F and G agree, obtaining (3), then (2) by identifying G_z with F_x, and (1) from (2); conclude (4) from the definition of the Euler characteristic (proof lines 6240-6249).

Prove (5) with the projection formula i_*(G tensor i^*E) = F tensor E together with the fact that i^*E is isomorphic to O_Z^{oplus n}, so that the Euler characteristic scales by the rank (proof lines 6249-6256).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the zero-dimensional scheme-theoretic support.
Use affineness and the Artinian structure to compute sections and vanishing.
Translate back along the closed immersion to obtain the first four properties.
Apply the projection formula and the rank computation on the zero-dimensional support for the last property.
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects five properties of a coherent sheaf F on a proper scheme over a field whose support has dimension at most zero: global generation, a description of H^0 as the direct sum of the stalks at the support, vanishing of higher cohomology, the resulting formula for the Euler characteristic, and chi(X, F tensor E) = n chi(X, F) for locally free E of rank n. The proof realizes F as i_*G for the scheme-theoretic support Z, which is zero-dimensional and hence affine and a finite disjoint union of spectra of local Artinian rings, so that G is globally generated with vanishing higher cohomology and H^0(Z, G) is the direct sum of the stalks (proof lines 6225-6247). The last item uses the projection formula together with i^*E being trivial of rank n on the zero-dimensional Z (proof lines 6249-6256). H2: the reduction to the zero-dimensional support and the rank count via the projection formula are the substance.
